Essays on agents, evals, post-training, model systems, and the practice of building with AI. Plus shorter notes and reflections.

I am also slowly compiling my CUDA kernel worklogs into
[*How to make your models fast*](https://athleticcoder21.github.io/inference-book/),
a small book focused, for now, on understanding and optimizing individual GPU
kernels from first principles.

I used to publish a weekly newsletter at [The Conductor](https://conductorbyam.substack.com/).
